title: v2.1.140 - Enhanced Agent Tool Matching and Bug Fixes
description: Released May 12, 2026, v2.1.140 improves agent tool subagent_type matching with case- and separator-insensitive values. Updated agent color palette, fixed /goal hanging with disableAllHooks, resolved settings hot-reload issues with symlinked files, fixed claude --bg connection drops, and improved background service startup on machines with enterprise endpoint security.

title: v2.1.139 - Agent View and /goal Command
description: Released May 11, 2026, adds agent view (Research Preview) showing all Claude Code sessions in a single list via 'claude agents'. Introduced /goal command to set completion conditions with live elapsed/turns/tokens overlay. Added /scroll-speed command, claude plugin details, transcript view navigation, and hook continueOnBlock config option.

title: May 2026 Updates - Enterprise Features and UI Improvements
description: Multiple updates throughout May 2026 including sensitive toggle for secrets with mask/visible options, merged multi-edits in progress tab, session category/subcategory in v3 API, wide markdown tables in chat, SSO connection picker, MCP OAuth token expiry warnings, and repository permissions decoupled from git integrations.

title: Market Dominance and $30B ARR Achievement
description: As of May 2026, Claude Code has become the most-used AI coding tool, overtaking GitHub Copilot and Cursor in just eight months since its May 2025 release. Anthropic disclosed $30B ARR with 80x year-over-year growth. Captures 30% of CLI-based coding market and Google engineers have adopted it for daily workflows.

Anthropic disclosed $30B ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) with 80x year-over-year growth

title: v2.2.17 - Devin Review & Quick Review
description: Released May 6, 2026, all Windsurf IDE users now have access to Devin Review and Quick Review with existing subscription. Devin Review available for self-serve users with 2 week free trial. Agent Command Center improvements include list display option, improved sorting/filtering, and performance enhancements. Fixed Windows update bugs and MCP server issues.

title: v0.41.0 - Real-time Voice Mode and Enhanced Shell Capabilities
description: Gemini CLI v0.41.0 released on May 5, 2026, introduces real-time voice mode with support for both cloud-based and local processing backends. The release also includes secure .env loading with workspace trust in headless mode, stronger shell command capabilities, and various bug fixes and improvements.

title: Main Branch - Expanded Model Support with Claude 4.5/4.6 and Gemini 3
description: Aider's main branch now supports Claude 4.5/4.6 models with updated model aliases (sonnet/haiku/opus). Expanded Gemini model support includes 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite, plus Gemini 3 preview models. Added DeepSeek Reasoner model support, BadGatewayError and ImageFetchError handling, and Fortran/Haskell/Julia/Zig repo map tagging.

title: v0.40.0 - Offline Search and Advanced Memory Management
description: Released April 28, 2026, v0.40.0 adds bundled ripgrep for offline search support and GitHub-style colorblind themes. Introduces MCP resource tools and a prompt-driven, four-tier memory management system. Also enables topic update narrations by default and streamlines Gemma local model setup.

title: Late April 2026 - MCP Marketplace and Theme Selector
description: Devin added Datadog and Amplitude to MCP marketplace as remote servers with OAuth authentication. Theme selector is now generally available with system theme as default. Wiki v2 now uses stronger reasoning with subagents for better documentation quality.

title: v0.86.0 - GPT-5 and Grok-4 Model Support
description: Version 0.86.0 expands GPT-5 model support across family variants and providers (OpenAI, Azure, OpenRouter), including dated and chat/mini/nano variants. This release demonstrates Aider's commitment to supporting the latest AI models as they become available. Aider wrote 88% of the code in this release.

title: Mid-April 2026 - Devin 2.2 with 3x Faster Startup
description: Devin 2.2 launch brings 3x faster startup time, new UI connecting the entire dev lifecycle, and smoother Slack/Linear integrations. Also introduced full desktop testing capability where Devin can QA PRs using computer control on Linux desktop apps.
